description.value: Sonora Resort is a five-star luxury wilderness resort on a remote BC island, part of the Relais & Châteaux collection, offering eco-adventure travel amid old-growth rainforest with abundant wildlife including eagles, whales, and bears. The resort combines elegant accommodation with world-class outdoor experiences including fishing, helicopter adventures, ocean excursions, and a full spa. It is positioned as a remote sanctuary most easily reached from Vancouver, making it an unusual but distinctive destination.

address.value: Sonora Island, Strathcona, BC V0P 1V0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sonora Resort is an active luxury wilderness eco-adventure resort, with a phone number (1-604-233-0460) visible site-wide. The site describes extensive amenities (spa, fitness centre, dining, wine cellar, helicopter and ocean adventures) but contains no mention of bike storage, laundry, bike tools, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenity, so all cycling criteria must be null. The resort is described as a remote island sanctuary accessible from Vancouver, suggesting water/helicopter access rather than road cycling access, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Resort appears to be on a remote island (Sonora Island) accessible primarily by boat or helicopter rather than by road — practical cycling access is uncertain and worth noting for directory users.
Phone number sourced from website only; OSM has no phone field to cross-check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable luxury resort with a live website and confirmed phone number. Remote island location is unusual for cycling tourism but does not disqualify it.
